entries.title: US actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Top Gun, Steel Magnolias and Alien, dies aged 93
entries.summary: The moustachioed star of several 20th century hit films died on Wednesday of natural causes, his family said.
entries.title_zh: 曾出演《壮志凌云》、《钢木兰》和《异形》的美国演员汤姆·斯凯里特去世，享年 93 岁
entries.summary_zh: 他的家人称，这位在 20 世纪几部热门电影中留着小胡子的明星于周三因自然原因去世。

entries.title: New York bans horse-drawn carriages after 160 years over safety and abuse concerns
entries.summary: As the council voted to banish the carriages, views in Central Park were divided over the 160-year-old tradition.
entries.title_zh: 出于安全和滥用问题，纽约在 160 年后禁止使用马车
entries.summary_zh: 当市议会投票废除马车时，中央公园对这一 160 年传统的看法出现了分歧。

entries.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
entries.summary: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.
entries.title_zh: 发现网络安全漏洞后竞相更新服务的计算机系统
entries.summary_zh: 在编程语言 PHP 的开发人员表示发现“严重漏洞”后，网站被下线。

entries.title: Ukraine hit by strikes after Russia agrees to new peace talks
entries.summary: The three waves of Russian missiles were launched at hours after Russia said it was "ready in principle" to resume peace talks with the US and Ukraine.
entries.title_zh: 俄罗斯同意新的和平谈判后乌克兰遭受袭击
entries.summary_zh: 俄罗斯发射三波导弹是在俄罗斯表示“原则上准备好”恢复与美国和乌克兰的和谈几小时后发射的。

entries.title: Trump says NBA star LeBron James 'disrespected' US anthem
entries.summary: The basketball star recently appeared to be practising a golf swing and basketball shots while the national anthem was performed.
entries.title_zh: 特朗普称NBA球星勒布朗·詹姆斯“不尊重”美国国歌
entries.summary_zh: 这位篮球明星最近似乎在奏国歌时练习高尔夫挥杆和篮球投篮。

entries.title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skin care sales
entries.summary: The beauty giant's CEO says the use of GLP-1s is "a very important phenomenon for us".

entries.summary_zh: 这家美容巨头的首席执行官表示，GLP-1 的使用“对我们来说是一个非常重要的现象”。

entries.title: Raye wins the Mercury Prize with This Music May Contain Hope
entries.summary: The pop star beat artists like Paul McCartney, Suede and Jade Thirlwall to lift the £25,000 prize.
entries.title_zh: 雷伊凭借《This Music May Contain Hope》荣获水星奖
entries.summary_zh: 这位流行歌星击败了 Paul McCartney、Suede 和 Jade Thirlwall 等艺术家，夺得了 25,000 英镑的奖金。

entries.title: Florida officer accused of stealing dead man's identity and moving into his home

entries.title: YouTuber arrested after popular Indian finance influencer's suicide
entries.summary: V Harish, who ran the hugely popular Instagram account "Finance with Harish", was found dead on Tuesday.
entries.title_zh: 印度著名金融影响者自杀后 YouTuber 被捕
entries.summary_zh: V Harish 是 Instagram 上广受欢迎的账户“Finance with Harish”的运营者，他于周二被发现死亡。

entries.title: Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
entries.summary: The congresswoman said federal agents seized over a dozen items, including cell phones and notebooks, as part of a federal investigation.

entries.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
entries.summary: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.

entries.summary_zh: 梅塔老板曾表示，他将因尚未生效的财富税而退出该州。

entries.title: Brook underlines status as world's best all-format batter in remarkable defeat
entries.summary: Once the disappointment of defeat dissipates, Harry Brook can reflect on another starring role with the bat which underlines his status as the world's best all-format batter, says Stephan Shemilt.
